sentences.text: The applicant has filed this first application u/S.438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.46 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Datia (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of IPC.
As per prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that he cheated the complainant and get the property transferred in his name by forged signature.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
It is further argued that the applicant is a 65 year old man.

As per prosecution story,
around 42 years back, the disputed transaction was done, however, the complainant never objected before any Revenue Authorities even after mutation in revenue records.
It is further argued that this case is of civil nature and has wrongly been given the colour of criminal case.
The sale-deed dated 15/01/1981 reveals that the sale-deed was executed in the house of complainant and the Registrar himself visited to complainant before registration of sale-deed.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is an Advocate, therefore, there is no likelihood of his absconsion.
The applicant is permanent resident of Sanichara Mohalla, District Datia (M.P.).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time.

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the applicant is ready and willing to co-operate in the investigation and shall abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court; therefore, he prays for grant of anticipatory bail.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel as well as counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the application and prays for rejection of present bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and material available on record, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on bail, on executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.100,000/-(Rupees One Lakh Only) with two local sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.
The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
